site.name: Gladys Mine
overview: Gladys Mine is a documented historic mine in Boulder County's Gold Hill area, preserved as a named feature on the USGS Gold Hill topographic quadrangle.
USGS-derived place data identifies the mine at approximately 40.036653, -105.386938.

timeline.text: The Gladys Mine formed part of the dense historic mining landscape around Gold Hill and Fourmile Canyon.
The mine remains preserved as a named mine feature on USGS-derived Gold Hill topographic mapping.

moreHistory: The mapped mine-level locality at approximately 40.036653, -105.386938 provides a defensible identification anchor. Remnant does not claim that the point is a field-surveyed surviving shaft, adit, or portal.
A focused exact-site media search did not verify a reusable Gladys Mine photograph with clear app-use rights, so no image is packaged rather than attaching nearby or uncertain material.
